tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Gradient on a level set] 1. ch7:7.7\group ch07-sobolev-spaces Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0164, gilbarg-trudinger:page-0165 If $u\in W^1(\Omega )$, then $Du=0$ almost everywhere on every measurable set on which $u$ is constant.
Proof

\sketch Subtract the constant and use $Du=Du^++Du^-$ together with (7.20).

□
